data.body: Final rollout evidence, with no elapsed-time wait: Gerrit change 1335 merged as f83fe247499fd95e68d67ba986d6a727313809e3 after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments; CI run 30868766601 passed all 15 jobs. Successful reconcile-bridge workflow run 30868993864 used github.sha 4213081d23f4549a03b882c9fa8bc9f44d9d5a07; git merge-base --is-ancestor e9a25ab84729be0bc9769614f8faa637a1411fac 4213081d... exited 0, directly proving the ephemeral writer ran an A2-1-descendant build. The host updater then published exact origin/main SHA 57c8d908a6c1ec67b47786429e9265033914ee10 through /Users/joeoakhart/.local/state/rebar-dev/current; git merge-base --is-ancestor f83fe24749 57c8d908a6 exited 0, so the global probe is an A2-2-descendant build. Both /Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar and rebar-mcp resolve into that exact-SHA release; Click is 8.4.2 and pip-audit reports no known vulnerabilities. Process census found no reconcile-bridge, probe-rebar, or rebar bridge process. Immediate launchd run 247 was exit 0/no-op. Thus both writer classes are explicitly refreshed and no older writer remains; the direct-evidence compatibility gate is satisfied without a fixed delay.
